description: The Settings window reads and changes Grape's settings through the settings_* commands, and edits the Shortcuts wheel's menus, shortcuts and steps through the shortcuts_* commands. It never sends a path: folders, apps and files are picked on the Rust side. It does send what the user typed for a shortcut (names, text, scripts, links). No command runs a shortcut. It can't call the store or autostart plugins directly.
